scopeNote: Left out on purpose: art. UB6 portail set back at least 3 m and the 4 m parking space before it (fences/parking); the list of cases allowing different road setbacks (annexes, pools, extensions, double rideau, RD, general-interest installations); art. UB8 sentence on extensions of existing buildings (only refers to UB6); art. UB10 R+1+comble storey count (not a metric figure), the general integration sentence, and the pigeonnier exception (ridge at most 3.5 m above the main building's ridge); art. UB11 roof slopes 30-35 % and 200 %, fences 1 m / 2 m; art. UB12 parking; art. UB13 planting rules with no figure (no green share set, no non-regulated statement); art. UB14 COS sans objet (floor area, out of scope); débroussaillement 50 m / 10 m in the preamble. No extension_max, annex_max or height_total figure is set.
draftedBy: Claude Opus 5.5 (a subagent), from the written conventions of the evaluation set
draftNote: Drafted from the chapter's text before any model's reading of it, by a model that saw only the chapter, the conventions and the product's definitions (never another truth, never a reading). Held-out zone of another document and layout. Judgement calls of the drafter: UB6, UB7 and UB8 each set a minimum and a maximum in one sentence; following one-rule-per-sentence I recorded only the minimum (5 m, 3 m, 4 m) and named the maxima (15 m, 10 m, 20 m) in the notes; a second reader could list the maxima as separate rules. | UBa road setback 'soit à l'alignement, soit à 3m minimum' recorded as limit min 3 m although alignment is also allowed; could be read as described. | UBa: the zone's 5-15 m road rule not repeated for UBa since the UBa paragraph replaces it; UBa inherits the other articles (UB7, UB8, UB9, UB10) but those sentences name no sector, so only sector null rules are listed. | UB10 pigeonnier ridge limit '3.5 m du faîtage de la construction principale' treated as an exception relative to another building, not a height_total limit. | UB10 7 m 'à l'égout du toit' classed height_facade; no total/ridge height is set. | UB9 'SANS OBJET .' listed as footprint_ratio not_regulated.

rules.quote: La façade des constructions principales sera comprise entre un retrait minimal de 5 m et un maximum de 15m des limites de l’emprise de la voie existante ou à créer, privée ou publique.
rules.note: Art. UB6: façade of main buildings between 5 m minimum and 15 m maximum from the road; minimum recorded (max 15 m in the same sentence).

rules.quote: soit à l’alignement, soit à 3m minimum de l’emprise de la voie existante ou à créer, privée ou publique.
rules.note: Art. UB6, secteur UBa: on the alignment or at least 3 m from the road.

rules.quote: ne pourra être inférieure à 3 m, sans toutefois excéder 10 mètres.
rules.note: Art. UB7: unless on the boundary, at least 3 m (and at most 10 m) from the boundary.

rules.quote: la distance entre deux constructions non contigües sur un même terrain doit être au minium de 4m, sans toutefois excéder 20 mètres, sauf impossibilité technique.
rules.note: Art. UB8: at least 4 m (and at most 20 m) between non-contiguous buildings, annexes and 'mas' excepted.
Art. UB9 emprise au sol: sans objet.

rules.quote: ne doit pas excéder 7m à l'égout du toit par rapport au côté haut du terrain naturel.
rules.note: Art. UB10: at most 7 m at the eaves (R+1+comble).

adopted.reason: The three sentences of articles 6, 7 and 8 that set a minimum AND a maximum distance (5 m and 15 m from the road, 3 m and 10 m from the boundary, 4 m and 20 m between buildings): the draft listed the minimum only; a maximum is a limit of its own (comparison max), so three rules are added.

notAdopted.quote: Toutefois, une exception sera faite pour la réalisation de bâtiment type pigeonnier dont la hauteur du faîtage ne pourra excéder 3.5 m du faîtage de la construc
